verdict: Spend is running but lead volume is critically low; action items are urgent.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads on $1,732.40 in total spend, a cost of $216.55 per lead — and the pace has slowed further, with just 1 lead in the last three days. The drop in volume traces directly to several overdue deliverables: the lead intake role is unconfirmed, the booking automation has not been tested, and four planned scale-up items — the Review Boost campaign, the Financing page, the Homer Glen branch, and the heating LSA re-enable — remain outstanding. We are pressing to resolve each of these blockers now, as they are the gate between current spend and real lead growth. Once the intake and automation issues are cleared, cost per lead should come down and volume should recover ahead of the October heating campaign launch.
